text: I've been holding on this line for nearly 40 minutes before I gave up and decided to text instead, so I hope someone actually reads this. I'm a childminder, I've got an 11 year old boy here until his parents pick him up after their late shift. He's had a temperature of 37.8 this evening, which is why I'm getting in touch at all, he was a bit warm when he came out of school. About an hour ago he bumped his head on the edge of the kitchen table reaching under it for a pencil. He cried straight away, proper loud, then had a cuddle and an ice pack and that was it. Since then he's been totally himself, chatting away, arguing with me about the TV, wide awake. I woke him from a doze on the sofa just now to check and he came round straight away and moaned at me for it. His parents will ask about the big bruise on his shin too. That's from falling off the climbing frame at the playground yesterday, he told me all about it, it's purple-green and he's walking on it fine. I just want to know whether the temperature and the head bump together are anything to worry about or whether I can tell his parents it's all fine, because I'm going to have to explain this to them and I'd like an answer I can actually give.
